name: steel vambraces
_design_note: F40-80 medium-heavy arms slot. Articulated forearm plate with flared wrist guard. Bridge between iron_vambraces and plate_vambraces.
lore_template: Articulated {material_name} vambraces hinged at the elbow for mobility, with a flared wrist-guard cup designed to catch and redirect blade strikes. The flare turns a parry into a counter — a small mechanical advantage that has consistently outlived the soldiers who relied on it.
